event: US retail sales, Tuesday 17 Nov 15:30 SAST. Then the Fed's October minutes, Wednesday 18 Nov 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Quiet Monday open
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,871 at 03:35 SAST, after opening near 3,886 and dipping to 3,860 in early Asia trade (xauad, single source).

bullets.title: Bad week behind
bullets.text: Gold fell about 4.5-5% last week, from a 4,149 Monday high to a 3,852 Thursday low (Kitco, FinanceFeeds).

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year is near 5.15% and the dollar index near 103.4, close to a 19-month high, which weighs on gold (FinanceFeeds).

bullets.title: Real yields rising
bullets.text: The 10-year real yield rose from 2.63% to 2.86% between 6 and 12 Nov, which makes gold less attractive (FXEmpire).

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: Futures price about 90% odds of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 Dec (CME FedWatch via FinanceFeeds).

bullets.title: Analysts lean bearish
bullets.text: In Kitco's survey, 10 of 13 Wall Street analysts expect lower gold this week, while retail voters are split.

bullets.title: Busy data week
bullets.text: Retail sales Tuesday, Fed minutes Wednesday and jobless claims Thursday can each move gold fast.

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,852-3,856 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,852-3,856, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping to the 3,852 low and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone, not a fast slice through it.
Softer yields or a weaker dollar at the same time.
Take some profit at 3,871 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying just because price looks cheap. Yields are above 5% and a Fed hike is priced in.
A strong retail sales number on Tuesday at 15:30 SAST can break 3,852 fast.
Thin Asia-session liquidity can spike through 3,852 and hit your stop.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close near 3,903.
Yields staying above 5% and the dollar above 103.

watch: Selling in the middle at 3,871, just above 3,860 support. Wait for the retest of 3,903.
Iran and oil headlines (Brent near 96 dollars) can lift gold fast through 3,926.
